WM5EAM.desc.name: Add mastery link to weapon descriptions
WM5EAM.desc.hint: Appends a link to the mastery's rule page at the end of each weapon's description.
WM5EAM.infer.name: Fill missing base items from weapon name
WM5EAM.infer.hint: When a Simple or Martial weapon has no base item, match it by name (e.g. 'Spiked Bone Club' becomes Club).
WM5EAM.autoTrigger.name: Automatically trigger masteries for
WM5EAM.autoTrigger.hint: Sets Automated Masteries 5e's auto-trigger for every user at login. 'Everyone on' or 'Everyone off' hides the per-player checkbox. 'Each player chooses' restores it.
WM5EAM.warn.name: Warn the GM about characters over their mastery limit
WM5EAM.warn.hint: Shows a warning and whispers the GM when a character knows more weapon masteries than the 2024 PHB allows for their class and level. Never changes data.
WM5EAM.reportButtons.name: Error and Unclear buttons on weapon cards
WM5EAM.reportButtons.hint: Adds Error and Unclear buttons under every weapon attack and damage card, so players can report a mastery problem.
WM5EAM.report.hintError: Report a weapon mastery that didn't happen or did the wrong thing.
WM5EAM.report.hintUnclear: Report a weapon mastery result that is hard to understand.
WM5EAM.report.introError: Tell the GM what went wrong with the weapon mastery on this roll.
WM5EAM.report.introUnclear: Tell the GM what is hard to understand about the weapon mastery on this roll.
WM5EAM.report.choice.expectedNone: I expected a mastery, but none happened
WM5EAM.report.choice.shouldItHappen: I don't know if a mastery should have happened
WM5EAM.report.choice.whatItDid: I don't understand what the mastery did
WM5EAM.report.disclaimer: Your comment is saved in this world's usedtp Logger log. The roll's weapon and mastery details are sent with it. Don't include real names or personal details.
WM5EAM.report.queued: No GM is online. Your report is saved in this browser and will be sent when a GM connects.
WM5EAM.homebrew.name: Allow house rules (homebrew)
WM5EAM.homebrew.hint: Off: weapon masteries follow the 2024 Player's Handbook exactly, and the house-rule settings below are ignored.
WM5EAM.npcMasteries.name: House rule: NPCs use weapon masteries
WM5EAM.npcMasteries.hint: PHB: only characters with a feature such as Weapon Mastery use masteries. Needs 'Allow house rules'.
WM5EAM.npcMasteries.feature: NPCs with a Weapon Mastery feature
WM5EAM.engine.otherActive: WM5E Auto Masteries: weapon masteries follow the 2024 PHB only when Automated Masteries 5e is off. Turn it off in Manage Modules. Until then, Automated Masteries 5e applies them.
WM5EAM.lines.toppleNotice: Topple: roll {target}'s DC {dc} Constitution save on the attack card.
WM5EAM.pushDirection.name: House rule: Push, the attacker picks the direction
WM5EAM.pushDirection.hint: PHB: straight away from the attacker. With this on, the attacker picks one of 8 directions. Needs 'Allow house rules'.
WM5EAM.pushSlide.name: House rule: Push slides 45 degrees when blocked
WM5EAM.pushSlide.hint: PHB: the push stops at the last open square. With this on, a blocked push tries 45 degrees left or right. Needs 'Allow house rules'.
WM5EAM.pushFull.name: House rule: Push always the full 10 ft
WM5EAM.pushFull.hint: PHB: up to 10 ft, the attacker chooses. With this on, the push goes as far as it can without asking. Needs 'Allow house rules'.
WM5EAM.push.distanceHint: Weapon mastery: push the target straight away from you, up to 10 ft.
WM5EAM.push.directionHint: House rule: pick the direction of the push.
